# `silk/json_object`

<!-- Generated by packages/compiler/scripts/generate-documentation.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Profiles: `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`.

Effectful JSON object construction through the ambient Writer.

## When to use

Use [`JsonObject`](#declaration-73696c6b2f6a736f6e5f6f626a6563743a3a4a736f6e4f626a656374) to write named values with a [`Serialize`](./json-codec.md#declaration-73696c6b2f6a736f6e5f636f6465633a3a53657269616c697a65) implementation.
Each operation keeps the object state in an Effect for the next operation.

## Details

The object owns its comma and depth state. It does not own or borrow the Writer.
A failed write can leave an accepted prefix in the Writer.

Import as `JsonObject` with `import silk.json_object { JsonObject }`.

Public declarations: 1.
